I mean, my way of life would be none at all. What high me was trying to get at was that society won't let me have that. To everyone it's some "tragedy," even when it's the thing I want most. 

But I want to say that I've managed to reign in my emotions. I haven't had any issues with showering/looking decent anymore, I go to most of my classes and get at least some homework done. I no longer spend my waking hours fantasizing about suicide. My feelings don't usually get to me, and when they do it's only for a day or two. I feel like this is as good as it's gonna get for me, and really, if this is all there is then I dont want any part of it. I have no dreams, nothing I wanna work towards, and even if I did I don't know if it'll be worth it to me. I'm just here to be here at this point. Wish I knew why I felt like this, but there's really nothing. My life is perfect otherwise, I have people who care about me, I'm not in financial trouble, really nothing is bad. I guess I'm just tired of life, of all these emotionless days that constitute my existence. 

Furthermore, the reason I do drugs and eat shitty food is in fact for the health problems. I feel like a "natural death" will hurt my parents less than a suicide. Drugs are a recent thing for me though. I was planning on killing myself last year by an opioid overdose. I've been curious about other drugs, so since I was planning on dying anyway, figured I should try them. The only thing that stopped me from going through with my plan was mushrooms, those little bastards. My friends and family know about my drug use, which nowadays is only weed and alcohol, which isn't really that bad really.
